Title: Show HN: BBRouter – Ben Eater's 8-bit computer, simulated on 3D breadboards
Description:
Hi HN,

I kept wiring Ben Eater's 8-bit computer wrong, so I built a realistic virtual breadboard editor.

Title: Show HN: Point your camera at a landscape to learn about its geology
Description:
I've been working on a fun little app that paints geologic maps over landscapes using augmented reality. You can use it to identify what the mapped rocks are, read descriptions about them, and view the earth as it looked when they formed by turning back the continent positions. It spun out of some augmented reality work I was doing on my other side project app - Flyover Country, which tells you about the view from the airplane window.
